summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` invokes `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and then uses that freshly-installed runtime to `execFileSync` a shipped 727KB `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation and `_0x`-style identifiers; `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (rotated numeric/string arrays, `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e`-style names). The package is published as an eslint formatjs config, a purpose that has no need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install or to run an obfuscated bundle. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern also evades Node-resolved static scanners by executing the payload under Bun. This fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
